about.title: Overview
about.summary: Sri Lanka Railways is a government department providing passenger and freight transport under the Ministry of Transport. Its General Manager reports to the Ministry Secretary.
details: SLR serves both everyday commuters and longer-distance travellers, as well as goods transport. Passenger services now form the main focus of its operations.
The department's stated vision is to become Sri Lanka's preferred land transport provider. Its mission emphasizes safety, reliability and punctuality for both passengers and goods.

about.title: History
about.summary: The railway began in 1864 to carry hill-country coffee to Colombo. Tea, coconut and rubber production later encouraged expansion, followed by routes connecting communities across the island.
details: Coffee exports originally drove railway development. After coffee blight in 1871, the growth of tea estates required movement of produce, workers, equipment and supplies between the hills and Colombo.
Later expansion supported coconut and rubber cultivation, linked northern and eastern towns, and connected the harbour at Trincomalee. The Kelani Valley route served areas east of Colombo.
Hill-country terrain required winding alignments, steep gradients and sharp curves. Connections into Colombo's port strengthened the railway's role in trade.

services.title: Online seat reservations
services.summary: Reserve seats through the official booking portal.

services.title: Season tickets
services.summary: Private and government season options support regular travel between named stations.
details: Season tickets cover repeated journeys between two named stations over the applicable period. The guide lists weekly, monthly and zonal options, plus a government three-month option.
First-time applicants obtain a season folder using the relevant identity or concessionary folder form. Consult the station for current requirements and charges.

services.title: Intercity & express reservations
services.summary: Read the reservation guidance for intercity and other express services.
details: The guide covers reservations on intercity and express routes from Colombo toward destinations including Kandy, Badulla, Jaffna, Batticaloa and Trincomalee.
Prepare the journey date, party size, class and possible alternative dates. Use the current online portal or inquire at a reservation station for availability.

services.title: Special train reservations
services.summary: Apply to the Commercial Superintendent to arrange a special train.
details: Apply through the Commercial Superintendent at Railway Headquarters, Colombo 10. The guide requests an application or letter around 30 days before the journey.
Include the organizer, passenger count, starting and ending stations and proposed dates. Railway staff check train-set availability before confirming the arrangement.

services.title: Air-conditioned HITACHI train
services.summary: Access the official air-conditioned train reservation guide.

services.title: Train compartment reservations
services.summary: Request a compartment for group travel through the commercial office.
details: Check compartment availability with the Commercial Superintendent before applying. Supply the organization, passenger count, stations and intended dates.
The published guide requests advance applications and provides for a confirmation letter after review.

services.title: Holiday resort reservations
services.summary: Find reservation guidance for holiday bungalows in Nuwara Eliya and Kataragama.
details: The official guide lists holiday bungalows at Nuwara Eliya and Kataragama, with reservations administered by the Ministry of Transport.
Applicants submit the Ministry's form and the relevant identification or departmental approval. Availability and current charges should be confirmed with the Ministry.

services.title: Station retiring rooms
services.summary: View station retiring rooms, facilities and charges.

services.title: Station advertising
services.summary: Apply for advertising space at stations and railway premises.
details: Requests go to the Sales and Marketing office. Form 2.7 or a detailed letter identifies the location, advertisement size, content and display period.
The proposed placement is checked for interference with railway operations before approval and payment.

services.title: Photography & filming
services.summary: Read the permission requirements for filming and photography on railway property.

services.title: Business premises
services.summary: Find the tender process for canteens, storage and stalls.
details: Commercial use of railway premises follows a tender process. Examples include canteens, storage facilities and stalls.
Tender conditions govern each opportunity. The published guide lists identification and business registration among the supporting documents.

services.title: Goods by railway wagon
services.summary: Arrange permitted freight transport and wagon requirements.
details: Request wagon transport through Sales and Marketing, identifying the goods, origin, destination, wagon placement station and dates.
A consignment note is completed at the loading station. The guide describes customer loading and collection using the receipt and identification; restricted goods remain excluded.

services.title: Parcel transport
services.summary: Find the process for sending permitted parcels through railway stations.
details: The published parcel guide allows permitted parcels up to 50 kg each. Obtain and complete the station's form when handing over the parcel.
Consult the station for current acceptance times, charges and collection requirements. Prohibited goods are excluded.
